intro: [Placeholder copy — to be written and checked with a rehabber.] Stay calm. Most of the time the kindest thing is a quiet, dark box and a quick call.

steps.title: Make sure they need help
steps.body: [Placeholder] Baby birds hopping on the ground are often fledglings with parents nearby. Watch from a distance first.

steps.title: Put them in a box
steps.body: [Placeholder] Gently place the animal in a cardboard box with air holes and a soft towel. Use gloves or a towel for your hands.

steps.title: Keep things dark and quiet
steps.body: [Placeholder] Close the box and put it somewhere warm, dark and quiet, away from pets, kids and noise.

steps.title: No food or water
steps.body: [Placeholder] Don't give food or water. The wrong food, or water in the wrong place, can hurt them.

steps.title: Call a rehabber
steps.body: [Placeholder] Call a licensed wildlife rehabilitator and follow what they say.
